opening.argument: The material promotes a purported Binance-related automated trading bot for free download, including the title “Binance Trading Bot 2022 | Crypto Trading Bot Free Download BOT” and an external “DOWNLOAD LINK ➲ https://cutt.ly/01tDntk.” It further directs viewers to “Disable / remove antivirus (files are completely clean)” and “Disable Windows Smart Screen” during download or installation. A visible “BINANCE BOT” application, a downloadable “Trade Bot.rar” archive, and extraction text reading “pass binance” reinforce that the instructions concern obtaining and installing the promoted program. The evidence does not establish the software’s provenance, official Binance affiliation, harmful behavior, account authorization, financial loss, or completed trades, but the download promotion and requests to bypass security protections establish the deceptive-risk basis for this claim.
